title: Formula induced by a restricted term
statement: Given a DNF term $T$ on $n$ coordinates and a coordinate restriction $ho$, its restriction formula is the one-term DNF consisting of the free restriction of $T$ if the restriction does not falsify $T$, and is the empty DNF otherwise.
